To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the high-Tc superconducting properties of the YBaCuO films can be significantly enhanced by a thin layer of CeO2, 2) the superconducting transition temperatures of YBaCuO thin films can be increased by the insertion of thin CeO2 buffer layers, and 3) the high-T c superconducting properties can be improved by the use of multilayer structures.

the growth of YBCO films by reactive coevaporation on sapphire wafers is feasible, that the growth of multilayer films is also feasible, and that the multilayer films exhibit superconducting transition temperatures that are higher than those of the YBCO films.

the high-Tc superconductor YBCO has been successfully grown by reactive co-evaporation on sapphire substrates, and that the YBCO/CeO _{2} /YBCO multilayers have a high critical temperature, Tc of 89.5 K, a critical current density Jc of 2.3 MA/cm ^{2} and a high critical current Ic of 0.5 A/cm.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the growth and characterization of high- T c YBa 2 Cu 3 O 7- d multilayers.
the growth of high-T c superconducting YBa 2 Cu 3 O 7-delta thin films on CeO 2 /sapphire substrates by co-evaporation in a high vacuum system.
the growth and characterization of multilayered superconducting films of YBCO and GdBCO, with and without buffer layers of CeO2 and/or MgO, on sapphire substrates.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, at present, the most promising method of preparing multilayered YBa _{2} Cu _{3} O _{7-δ} -based superconductors is the reactive co-evaporation method.
the YBa2Cu3O7-x/CeO2/YBa2Cu3 O7-x multilayer system is a promising material for the development of high-Tc superconducting electronic devices, such as SQUIDs and Josephson junctions.
, the superconducting properties of YBCO thin films are strongly influenced by the oxygen content of the film and the substrate, and the film thickness.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a new method for the fabrication of high quality YBCO films on sapphire substrates.
we have developed a method of growing multilayered structures with the desired properties.
the YBa2Cu3O7-delta -CeO2-YBa2Cu3 O7-delta multilayered films grown on the sapphire substrates by reactive co-evaporation technique have been successfully fabricated.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the multilayer structure can be grown on a single substrate and the superconducting properties of the individual layers can be maintained, even when the layers are in direct contact with each other.
we have developed an effective and reliable way to produce YBCO/CeO2/YBCO multilayers with the desired structure and properties, using reactive co-evaporation.
we have demonstrated that the growth of high-quality YBCO films on a CeO2 template is possible using the reactive co-evaporation method.
